source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The added test verifies that deleteMessages removes the chosen keys from listAllKeys. Its getMsgHdrForKey failure assertion is commented out because legacy lookup may still return a deleted header. The fixed test retains that limit, and legacy lookup still tries its cache before a store lookup whose condition ignores hasOid. Review speculation about dependent callers was not traced. The assigned historical Panorama DeleteMessages is unimplemented; its later accepted removal loop is not proof that this exact historical test passed on both backends. No test ran.
title: Deletion enumeration and header lookup are separate database contracts
